name: Eldritch Master
description: Spend 1 minute asking your patron for aid to get back every spent Pact Magic slot.
Then it is locked until your next long rest.

name: Fey Presence
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: A wave of fey charm and menace spreads from you in a 10 ft cube. Each creature inside makes a Wisdom save against your warlock spell save DC.
Those who fail are charmed by you or frightened of you (you choose which), lasting to the end of your next turn.
Recharges on a short or long rest.

name: Misty Escape
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Taking damage lets you dissolve into mist. Use your reaction to go invisible and teleport up to 60 ft to a free space in sight.
Invisibility holds until your next turn begins, unless you attack or cast a spell first. Recharges on a short or long rest.

name: Beguiling Defenses
trigger: A creature tries to charm you
description: Charm cannot affect you. When a creature attempts it anyway, spend your reaction to reflect the effect back. That creature rolls a Wisdom save against your warlock spell save DC, and on a failure you have it charmed for 1 minute, or sooner if it is hurt.

name: Dark Delirium
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Choose a creature within 60 ft that you can see. It makes a Wisdom save against your warlock spell save DC. If it fails, you decide whether it is charmed or frightened. This lasts 1 minute, but stops if your concentration breaks or the target takes damage.
The target thinks it is lost in a mist-filled realm you design, and perceives only itself, you and that illusion.
Recharges on a short or long rest.

name: Dark One's Blessing
trigger: You reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points
description: Whenever you drop a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you receive temporary hit points: your Charisma modifier plus your warlock level, with a minimum of 1.

name: Dark One's Own Luck
trigger: You make an ability check or saving throw
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: After seeing the roll of an ability check or saving throw you make, but before its effect lands, add a d10 to it.
Recharges on a short or long rest.

name: Hurl Through Hell
trigger: You hit a creature with an attack
description: When you hit with an attack, send the target through the lower planes. It vanishes and comes back at the end of your next turn, in its old space or the nearest open one.
A target that isn't a fiend takes 10d10 psychic damage from the ordeal.
Recharges on a long rest.

name: Entropic Ward
trigger: A creature makes an attack roll against you
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: When a creature rolls an attack against you, use your reaction to give that roll disadvantage. If it still misses, your next attack against that creature has advantage, provided you make it by the end of your following turn.
Recharges on a short or long rest.

name: Create Thrall
description: Touch a humanoid that is incapacitated. It stays charmed by you until someone casts remove curse on it, the charm is lifted another way, or you use this feature again.
While you both share a plane, you can speak to the thrall mind to mind.

name: Agonizing Blast
description: Eldritch blast deals extra damage equal to your Charisma modifier on each beam that hits, so it grows with the extra beams you gain later.

name: Armor of Shadows
description: Cast mage armor on yourself whenever you like. It uses no spell slot and needs no material components. Recast it when it runs out.

name: Ascendant Step
description: Cast levitate on yourself at will, with no spell slot and no material components. Rise above enemies, traps and gaps whenever you need to.

name: Beast Speech
description: Cast speak with animals as often as you like. It never costs a spell slot, so you can chat with any beast you meet.

name: Beguiling Influence
description: You gain proficiency in Deception and in Persuasion. Nothing to activate; it is a permanent bonus whenever you roll those skills.

name: Bewitching Whispers
description: Cast compulsion once by spending a warlock spell slot. You cannot do this again until you finish a long rest.

name: Book of Ancient Secrets
description: Pick two 1st-level spells with the ritual tag, from any class list, and write them in your Book of Shadows. They do not count as spells known, and you cast them only as rituals with the book in hand. Warlock spells you already know that carry the tag can be cast as rituals too.
You can copy more rituals you find into the book if the spell level is no more than half your warlock level, rounded up. Each spell level takes 2 hours and 50 gp of ink.

name: Chains of Carceri
uses: At will, once per creature per long rest
description: Cast hold monster at will, with no slot or material components, but only against a celestial, fiend or elemental. After you use it on a creature, you must finish a long rest before targeting that same creature again.

name: Devil's Sight
description: You see normally in darkness, magical or not, out to 120 feet. Always on, with nothing to activate.

name: Dreadful Word
description: Cast confusion once by spending a warlock spell slot. Wait for a long rest before doing it again.

name: Eldritch Sight
description: Cast detect magic at will, without spending a spell slot. Use it as often as you like, including as a ritual.

name: Eldritch Spear
description: Your eldritch blast reaches out to 300 feet instead of its normal range, so you can strike from far outside enemy reach.

name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
description: You can read any writing, in any language or script. It is always on, so there is nothing to activate.

name: Fiendish Vigor
description: Cast false life on yourself at will, always as a 1st-level spell. It needs no spell slot and no material components, so you can refresh your temporary hit points after every fight.

name: Gaze of Two Minds
description: Touch a willing humanoid. Until the end of your next turn you perceive through its senses, including any special senses it has, while you are blind and deaf to your own surroundings.
Spend your action on later turns to keep the link going another turn. It works only while you share a plane of existence with the creature.

name: Lifedrinker
description: Every pact weapon hit adds necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier; the bonus is never below 1.

name: Mask of Many Faces
description: Cast disguise self at will, with no spell slot spent. Change your look as often as you like.

name: Master of Myriad Forms
description: Cast alter self at will, with no spell slot spent. Reshape your own body as often as you like.

name: Minions of Chaos
description: Cast conjure elemental once by spending a warlock spell slot. Take a long rest before using this again.

name: Mire the Mind
description: Cast slow once by spending a warlock spell slot. You regain this use after a long rest.

name: Misty Visions
description: Cast silent image at will. It uses no spell slot and no material components, so you can conjure illusions as often as you like.

name: One with Shadows
description: While you stand in dim light or darkness, use your action to turn invisible. You stay invisible until you move, take an action or take a reaction.

name: Otherworldly Leap
description: Cast jump on yourself at will, with no spell slot and no material components. Use it whenever you need to clear a gap.

name: Repelling Blast
description: When eldritch blast hits a creature, you may shove it up to 10 feet directly away from you.

name: Sculptor of Flesh
description: Cast polymorph once by spending a warlock spell slot. You cannot do so again until a long rest.

name: Sign of Ill Omen
description: Cast bestow curse once by spending a warlock spell slot. Finish a long rest to use it again.

name: Thief of Five Fates
description: Cast bane once by spending a warlock spell slot. It is available again after a long rest.

name: Thirsting Blade
description: When you take the Attack action, you can attack twice with your pact weapon instead of once.

name: Visions of Distant Realms
description: Cast arcane eye at will, with no spell slot spent. Scout around corners and through walls as often as you like.

name: Voice of the Chain Master
description: You can talk to your familiar telepathically and see and hear through it, as long as you share a plane.
While perceiving through it, you can also speak with your own voice through the familiar, even if it normally cannot talk.

name: Whispers of the Grave
description: Cast speak with dead at will, with no spell slot spent. Question a corpse as often as the situation allows.

name: Witch Sight
description: You see the true form of shapechangers and of creatures hidden by illusion or transmutation magic, as long as they are within 30 feet and in your line of sight.

name: Pact of the Chain
description: You learn find familiar, which does not count against your spells known, and can cast it as a ritual. You may pick an imp, pseudodragon, quasit or sprite as its form, as well as the usual ones.
When you take the Attack action, you can skip one of your attacks so your familiar makes one attack of its own.

name: Pact of the Blade
description: Use your action to conjure a melee pact weapon in your empty hand, in any form you like. You are proficient with it and it counts as magical against resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.
It vanishes if it is more than 5 feet from you for 1 minute, if you dismiss it (no action) or summon it again, or if you die. An hour-long ritual can bind a magic weapon as your pact weapon.

name: Pact of the Tome
description: Your patron hands you a Book of Shadows. Take three cantrips of any class. Carrying the book lets you cast them freely, and they do not eat into your cantrips known.
If the book is lost, a 1-hour ceremony during a rest gets you a new one.
